identity_and_source_backed_footprint.finding: Purdue identity and GIS FID 227 support the correct building and plan envelope. Shell/plinth bounds closely follow the transformed GIS bounds; the local projection and AABB comparison are not survey control or a full wall-shape check.

position_orientation_and_scale.finding: The retained R8 read-only master check shows one expected placement instance at the manifest coordinates within 0.02 m, zero rotation, unit scale, and a relative library path. This registration evidence was not freshly repeated in R11; the project's local coordinate transform is approximate.

evidence_backed_height_floors_and_roof.finding: Purdue Archives supports the ten-story identity, and the newly inspected undated drawing shows a flat parapet and raised rear roof silhouette qualitatively. The modeled shell tops at 33.2 m and coping at 36.5 m, while 2018 DSM-minus-DTM p50 is 36.92 m and p95 is 40.43 m. The raster's footprint-wide 5-ft cells, unresolved vertical datum, and lack of component attribution cannot establish which modeled roof component or story is wrong. No geometry change is justified.

facade_entrances_and_distinctive_archite.finding: The archive photograph directly shows a mostly blank end wall next to vertically grouped windows; the drawing shows vertical facade bands, simpler end bays, lower-level glazing, and a raised rear roof edge. The building's broad massing and window rhythm are plausible in the saved renders. Neither archive image is dated, direction-identified, dimensioned, or confirmed as-built/current, so facade coverage, current openings, exact entrance placement, and correspondence to model cardinal faces remain unverified. Blank rendered areas cannot be scored as verified elevations.

modular_export_portability_and_complete_.finding: The standalone asset reopens in Blender 5.2.3 with the expected collection, 550 direct/593 inclusive objects, stable bounds, and no unpacked image dependencies. R11 adds structured source observations and limits, while existing GIS, raster, floor-plan, render, and placement evidence is retained. The master integration check is from R8 rather than a fresh R11 integration audit, and current elevation/interior coverage remains incomplete.

findings: R11 changed evidence only; no building geometry or placement changed.
The two newly inspected archive images substantiate broad historical design motifs but cannot be assigned to model cardinal elevations or current as-built conditions.
The roof-height discrepancy remains unresolved at component level. The 2018 DSM/DTM is not a measured architectural elevation.
The R11 validation confirms the standalone asset reopens and has no unpacked image dependencies; the read-only master placement evidence is retained from R8.
The asset does not meet the 8.0/10 threshold under the five equally weighted project criteria.
method: Five project rubric criteria, each worth up to 2 points; total is the sum rounded to one decimal.
